item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Rell - The Remedy (2025) Lossless
item.description:
Greetings, does anyone have this album in Lossless by Rell? Fun Fact: This was originally supposed to be his 2001 debut album but never got released until this year on streaming. This album is a diamond in the rough and was highly anticipated in 2001 by R&B fans. Thank you for whoever can find this in Lossless WAV, FLAC, Apple Music etc.
